title: Clan
html:
Not to be confused with Ally or Alliance.

A Clan is a group of players in OpenFront who display a common tag. It is set by putting a tag in your username (for example, “[TAG] Player”).


Mechanics

Members of the same clan are automatically placed on the same team in team-based modes.

Exception

In Free for All (FFA) mode, clan tags do not confer any team affiliation; all participants compete individually, regardless of clan membership.
